name: FleetPartners Group Limited
summary: FleetPartners Group Limited provides fleet management services in Australia and New Zealand. The company operates through three segments: Australia Commercial, Novated, and New Zealand Commercial. It offers vehicle sustainable fleet and leasing, fleet services, driver services, introducer and broker partnerships, and vehicle accessories. The company also provides novated leasing and salary packaging services, vehicle acquisition, in-life fleet management and vehicle remarketing, and driver services under the FleetPartners brand.
